# Kryssen Growth Studio

> Kryssen helps Nigerian businesses turn company expertise into Education-Led Growth™: answers, decision tools, customer learning and market insight connected to buyer decisions and observable commercial signals.

## Start
- [Homepage](https://kryssengrowth.com/): overview of the Education-Led Growth™ system.
- [Apply for a fit review](https://kryssengrowth.com/apply.html): adaptive application reviewed by Kryssen before a potential call.
- [Education Opportunity Finder](https://kryssengrowth.com/quiz.html): a no-score starting-point finder with no email gate.
